text.p: These are the main headlines of the news reported by Radio Latvia on Thursday at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- Baltic prime ministers meet in Tallinn with the EU's enlargement plans as the main theme of their talks. The creation of a Baltic customs union is also on the agenda.
- Foreign ministers of the NATO countries gather for their last meeting before the Madrid summit.
- Judicial officials calls for a speedier amendment of the credit institution law, passed in the wake of the 1995 banking crisis.
